title: gait-extract/1
description: The tracked extract of one gait record (sim/benchmarks/gait_extract.json): exactly what sim/runs/ENVELOPE.md prints in its gait section, stamped like sim/benchmarks/walk_reference.json, so the envelope can be regenerated from a clean clone. Written by `fy gait <spec> --write-extract` (sim/scripts/gait_extract.py); CONVENTIONS section 6. Torques are N m about the model's hinge axes, speeds rad/s, powers W, angles degrees. `results` is keyed by speed and trunk mode and holds, per joint, method and metric, the 95th percentile and maximum across subject-strides under each exclusion set the source record has (all, without_offset, without_pitch_flagged). `lumbosacral` holds the lumbosacral lateral and axial joints for rigid, counter_rotate and first_harmonic (the T3c.2 median gain and lag, and the four quartile corners) as {median, p95, max} over every subject-stride. `a_filtered_sagittal` holds, per speed and limb (and per stem with both limbs pooled), the dataset's own peak moment scaled to Freyja ({mean, p95, max} N m), the OLS slope of A_filtered against the dataset per kg, and the ratio of A's mean peak per kg to the dataset's. `hip_demand` holds peak hip extension from the vertical and relative to the pelvis (the dataset's inverse kinematics) and the median posterior pelvic tilt. No row carries a threshold or a flag.

gait_id.description: the source record; its gait.json is untracked

trunk.description: the record's trunk modes in spec order; first_harmonic appears only in `lumbosacral`

band.description: per method and exclusion set: the envelope band verdict {meets, joints{stem{corr, rms_pct_ptp, meets}}}

agreement.description: per method, stem (both limbs pooled) and exclusion set: {corr, rms_pct_ptp}

joints.description: joint -> method -> metric -> exclusion set -> {p95, max}; joints above the pelvis carry method B only

lumbosacral.description: speed -> joint (lsj_lat, lsj_ax) -> variant -> metric -> {median, p95, max}

a_filtered_sagittal.description: speed -> joint or stem -> {scaled_peak_nm{mean, p95, max}, ols_slope, peak_ratio}

hip_demand.description: speed -> {vertical_deg{median, p95, max}, pelvis_relative_deg{median, p95, max}, posterior_pelvic_tilt_median_deg}
